# documented global flags (README Global Flags table)

# --json flag
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input --json version
stdout '"version"'

# --quiet flag
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input --quiet version

# --no-color and --no-input flags (already used above, but validate explicitly)
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input --help
stdout 'Deploy and manage containerized applications on the Musher platform'

# the documented flag set
stdout '--api-key'
stdout '--api-url'
stdout '--json'
stdout '--no-color'
stdout '--no-input'
stdout '--no-tui'
stdout '--profile'
stdout '--quiet'

# --no-tui is accepted by every command
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input --no-tui version

# a bare musher without a terminal prints help instead of opening the TUI
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color
stdout 'Deploy and manage containerized applications on the Musher platform'
